svg.title: English ciphertext: original print and corrected reconstruction
svg.desc: Original 595-letter transcript on the left; corrected 650-letter ciphertext on the right. Red boxes mark fifteen changed letters in both panels. A red rectangle encloses the recovered ninth line in the right panel. Original line breaks are preserved. The final group PKYSK remains unchanged.
svg.text: A missing line. Fifteen changed letters.
Wetherell’s English Vigenère puzzle · exact ciphertext comparison
595 letters · missing line and printed errors preserved
Original line breaks retained; the printed message has only 11 lines.
650 letters · missing line restored + 15 letter corrections
Corrections are inferred from the source prose. Final group PKYSK is unchanged; the full plaintext ending remains FINI HARI.
